biography:
Leo Thompson, a name whispered with a mix of admiration and trepidation in the junior racing circuits, hails from the sun-drenched streets of Valencia, Spain. Growing up, the roar of engines from the nearby Ricardo Tormo Circuit was the soundtrack to his life, igniting a passion that burned brighter than the Mediterranean sun. His first taste of competitive racing came in karting, where his aggressive overtaking maneuvers and fearless attitude quickly earned him a reputation. A defining moment came at the Spanish National Karting Championship where, despite starting last after a mechanical issue, he clawed his way to victory in the final lap, showcasing his raw talent and unwavering determination.

Transitioning to single-seaters, Thompson faced initial struggles with adapting to the more technical aspects of racing. However, his relentless work ethic and sheer grit saw him steadily improve, culminating in a podium finish at the Formula Renault Eurocup race in Monaco. This performance caught the attention of several independent teams, eager to harness his potential. Currently, Thompson is navigating the fiercely competitive Formula 3 championship, honing his skills and aiming to make the leap to Formula 2 in the near future. He knows he has to prove himself to get noticed, and he's willing to do anything to make that happen.

Despite lacking the financial backing of some of his rivals, Thompson's unwavering self-belief and aggressive driving style make him a formidable opponent on the track. His underdog status fuels his ambition, turning every race into a personal battle for recognition. He represents the kind of raw, untamed talent that teams are willing to take a chance on, hoping he is the next big thing.
drivingStyle: Thompson's driving style is characterized by an aggressive, late-braking approach that often borders on the audacious. He is known for his daring overtakes, frequently diving down the inside with unwavering commitment. While this occasionally leads to mistakes, it also yields spectacular results. Tire management is an area he's actively working on, learning to balance his aggressive driving with the need to preserve his rubber. Under pressure, Thompson tends to thrive, channeling his intensity into even more focused and decisive driving.

rivalries.reason: A clash of personalities and racing styles. Rossi represents the established order, while Thompson is the brash newcomer challenging the status quo.
A series of on-track incidents, including a controversial collision at Monza, has created a tense rivalry between Thompson and Dubois.
They consistently compete for the same positions, leading to intense battles and a mutual respect tinged with fierce competition.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky wristband given to him by his grandmother before every race.
Listens to a specific flamenco song before getting into the car to calm his nerves.
Visually traces the outline of the circuit in the air with his finger during the national anthem.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about being safe; it's about pushing limits. If you're not on the edge, you're taking up space."
careerHighlight: Winning the Formula Renault Eurocup race at Monaco after qualifying in tenth place; a true testament to his overtaking prowess.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Spanish F3 Championship race at Jerez due to over-aggression, costing him valuable championship points.
